user.title: Lite Resources
user.description: Choose the users (for example a wall panel's login) that should load only the custom cards their dashboards use. Everyone else keeps loading all resources.

data.include_unscannable: Include resources that can't be checked
data.filter_states: Only send states their dashboards show

data_description.users: These users get the reduced resource list on every device they log in on.
data_description.dashboards: Every dashboard these users open. Resources their cards need are loaded; the rest are skipped.
data_description.always_include: Resources to load regardless, e.g. a mod used by a theme.
data_description.include_unscannable: Resources served by integrations or other sites can't be read; keep them loaded (recommended).
data_description.filter_states: Stream live updates only for entities on their dashboards (plus group members). Big CPU saving on slow panels; other entities show as unavailable for these users.
data_description.extra_entities: Entities to keep streaming even though they aren't on the dashboards.
